build.title: Recompute Data
build.confirm:
This recomputes the comparison from the newest WINGS export (02) and the newest production-month SAM folder (01) on SharePoint.
It runs in this browser (1–3 minutes) and the result is saved to SharePoint (05. output) for everyone.
The model mapping workbook (03. model_rules) also gets its recognition and diagnostics sheets refreshed.

Continue?
